description: For each argument list of Database.OpenRecordset ["F" ;; SQL over F ;; "QP" (parameter query) ;; F, Long 0 ;; F, Long 1 ;; SQL, Long 1 ;; F, Integer 2 ;; F, "2" ;; F, Null ;; F, Empty ;; F, Long 3 ;; F, Long 5 ;; F, Long 16 ;; F, Long 32 ;; F, Missing, Long 4 ;; F, Long 2, Missing, Long 3 ;; F, Long 2, Long 0, Long 0 ;; F, Long 2, Long 0, Long 2, Long 0 ;; F, Long 8 ;; F, Long 2, Long 256 ;; "", Long 2 ;; NoSuch, Long 2 ;; Null, Long 2 ;; SQL WHERE 1 = 0, Long 4 ;; F, Long 2, Long 8]: call it, read Type, Updatable, Bookmarkable, EOF, RecordCount and Name; close. Asks the default recordset type for a table name and for SQL, the refused type and option values, the accepted VARIANT types, omitted middle arguments and excess arguments. The fixture copy is opened read-only.
